description: Ready to Print: make a design print-ready by enlarging it 1-4x with AI detail. Best for: making a finished design print-ready: enlarging low-res buyer, archive or small-format files 1-4x with AI-filled detail and no pixelation, with your target DPI written into the file. Result files are saved to disk and their paths returned.

creativity.description: Creativity, shown to users as 6-70% (Less 20%, More 45%, A lot 70%); send it as a decimal, 0.06-0.7. Lower stays closer to the original pixels. Recommended 35% (the website's Advanced default; its Basic view uses 45%).

dpi.description: Output resolution in ppi (72-500). Omit to keep the image's own resolution.

estimate_only.description: Only return the credit estimate; nothing is uploaded or charged.

image.description: Source image: a local file path or an http(s) URL. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 80 MB and 5000 px per side.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: the folder of the input image (or the current directory for URL inputs). Files are never overwritten.

output_format.description: Output Format: png (PNG, Recommended): Lossless PNG file. jpeg (JPEG): Smaller JPEG file. Required: pass the mode the user named. If the user did not name one, omit it and the tool returns the modes to show them; never choose for the user.

prompt.description: Prompt: optional text to guide the enhancement, e.g. 'floral chiffon print, fine linework'.

resemblance.description: Resemblance: how closely the result must match the input, 0-100 (Fresh 20, Similar 60, Same 100). Raise it if the result drifts. Default 60.

review_settings.description: Omit it and the tool first asks whether to use the recommended settings or adjust them (unless the call already sets some). true: ask each setting one by one. false: run with the given or recommended settings without asking; pass it only after the user chose that.

scale_factor.description: Scale Factor 1-4: how much larger the output is. Default 2.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the job before returning its task_id (default 240).

unlimited_bundle.description: Request the Unlimited bundle for this run (only has effect on Unlimited plans; the server decides).

wait.description: Wait for the job and save the outputs (default true). false returns the task_id right after submit.

name: td_ready_to_print
title: Ready to Print
